meaning: Research candidate rights register; NOT an authorization to use any image or weight in a commercial product.

statusVocabulary.candidate: source-level license appears permissive; exact artifact provenance and obligations are unverified
statusVocabulary.hold: commercial or personal-image rights not established; no ingestion
statusVocabulary.restricted: explicit noncommercial/research-only terms; commercial use prohibited unless separately authorized
statusVocabulary.review: bespoke data-use terms or unclear downstream rights; human/legal review needed
statusVocabulary.approved: requires a separately signed/recorded specific-source commercial rights review, verified source-image rights and privacy/personality rights; not asserted for any asset currently
